evidence: log loss +0.0124 (95% interval +0.0032 to +0.0209). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

256 picks, ROI +1.1% (95% interval -8.6% to +10.3%), win rate 60.2% against a break-even 58.9%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 16% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.15 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,869 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,753; a 1% edge takes 43,814. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
